_doc: kevin001 robot configuration: the ONE place the robot's selectable parts and targets are set. src/robot_params.py resolve() turns this + the selected profiles (src/tire_profiles.json, src/twin_geometry.json, src/calibration.json) into one flat resolved table (value, units, source); every process reads only that. Inspect: python -m src.robot_params show [--wheels X] [--diff stock] [--json]. Override the wheels with env KEVIN_WHEELS (KEVIN_TIRE = legacy alias).

drive._doc: rim targets; the ODrive turn limits are derived per wheel (turns = m/s / (2 pi R)). Values = the 2026-09 ODrive settings 4.0 turns/s, 3.0 / 5.0 turns/s^2 on the 85.65 mm stock wheel (James approved keeping the rim values per tyre, a4224de).

perception._doc: cliff_z0_ref_m: expected RS1 floor depth at ride_dz 0 (stock); resolved = ref + the wheels' ride_dz. td_obstacle_h_m: RS1 obstacle threshold above the floor; td_floor_clip_m = rs1_height_m - td_obstacle_h_m (one clip everywhere, James 2026-10-21).

body._doc: twin body outline in the axle frame (m): SIL12 polygon (kplan/MuJoCo) + simready lite deck corners. FOOTPRINT_SAFE = hull(sil12 + deck_corners + the wheels' tread corners (+-wheel_r_free, +-tread_y_out)).

cameras._doc: RealSense settings, applied once at pipeline start by src/cameras.py (no per-frame work). 2026-10-21 (James: sun blinded the depth cameras): the old manual depth exposure 15 ms / gain 64 saturated the IR in daylight (fill RS1 0.16, RS2 0.01; 79-97 % IR px saturated); auto exposure with the firmware AE limit keeps 30 Hz (exposure can never exceed depth_ae_limit_us < 33.3 ms) and fills 0.66 / 0.63 (scripts/rs_exposure_eval.py). Colour: auto exposure with priority 0 (constant 30 Hz), AE ROI on the WhiBal card (RS1) / the floor (RS2), fixed white balance; rgb_card_gains = per-channel gains that make the card neutral at that white balance (scripts/color_card_eval.py; consumers apply them with src/color_cal.py). exposure_mode legacy = the pre-2026-10-21 manual settings (env KEVIN_CAM_EXPOSURE overrides).
